Great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

- Band C (APAC-safe): 19:00–21:00 SGT / 10:00–12:00 BST (best for APAC attendees, pushes Redwood office-hours on rotation)

Attachments: I attached a one-page Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v1.pdf) and a sample rotating_schedule.csv with suggested slots.

Can you confirm: 
1) which band you'd prefer for the pilot week (we're proposing the week of July 7 as a pilot), and
2) who from your team we should include on the invite for the deep technical session?

If those are okay, I'll loop in our solutions engineer (Karthik) and ops (Monica) to finalize invites and the short agenda.
